This section lists the audio and video formats detected at the entered URL.
Each result shows the file format first, followed by the codec used to encode it and its bitrate in kilobits per second (kbps).
For example, m4a (mp4a.40.2, 129.5 kbps) is an M4A file using the mp4a.40.2 codec with a bitrate of 129.5 kbps.
If a codec is not detected, it is displayed as none. Multiple results are separated by a vertical bar (|).
For more information about codecs, refer to the [[[button:Codec description in "Playlist Editor"][../Playlist Editor]]] page.
